subject: DI04000251

h.en: 7.1.1 Select the bearing for its duty, not just its bore
h.gu: 7.1.1 Bearing ફક્ત Boreથી નહિ,Dutyથી પસંદ કરો

body.en:
Start with the situation

Two bearings fit the same shaft, but differ in axial capability, speed, life, clearance and sealing. The dimensions alone do not choose the bearing.

Definition / principle

A bearing supports relative motion while transmitting load through sliding or rolling contact.

Understand why

Selection starts with load direction, magnitude, speed, life, environment, space and arrangement.

Application / illustration

Calculate rating life and equivalent load, then check catalogue limits, fits, lubrication and static capacity.

Common mistake / conditions

A calculatedL10 is a statistical basic rating life, not a guarantee that every bearing lasts that long.

Is basic bearing life a guaranteed retirement date?

No. It is a statistical fatigue-life rating under reference conditions.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

બે bearings same shaftમાં fit થાય,પણ axial capability,speed,life,clearance,sealing જુદાં હોય;ફક્ત dimensionsથી પસંદગી નહિ.

Definition / Principle

Bearing sliding/rolling contact દ્વારા load transfer કરીને relative motion support કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Selectionની શરૂઆત load direction,magnitude,speed,life,environment,space,arrangementથી થાય.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Rating life,equivalent load ગણો;પછી catalogue limits,fits,lubrication,static capacity જુઓ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Calculated L10 statistical basic rating life છે,દરેક bearing એટલું ચાલશે તેની guarantee નહિ.

Basic Life Guaranteed Retirement Date છે?

ના.Reference conditionsનું statistical fatigue-life rating છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Contact mechanism and load direction are independent classification ideas.

Understand why

Sliding/plain bearings include journal, thrust and guide arrangements with suitable lubrication.

Rolling/anti-friction bearings use balls or rollers between raceways; they still have friction.

Radial bearings mainly support radial loads; thrust bearings mainly axial loads; some types support combined loads.

Locating and non-locating bearing arrangements manage shaft positioning and thermal expansion.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Contact mechanism,load direction classificationના જુદા ideas છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Sliding/plainમાં suitable lubrication સાથે journal,thrust,guide arrangements આવે.

Rolling/anti-frictionમાં raceways વચ્ચે balls/rollers;friction હજી હોય છે.

Radial મુખ્યત્વે radial,thrust મુખ્યત્વે axial;અમુક types combined loads લે.

Locating/non-locating arrangements shaft position,thermal expansion સંભાળે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Rings, raceways, rolling elements and cage guide load transfer while allowing rotation.

Understand why

The inner ring normally seats on the shaft and outer ring in the housing; which ring rotates is service-dependent.

Balls/rollers carry contact load; the cage separates and guides elements rather than carrying the main radial load.

Seals/shields, lubricant, internal clearance and preload affect contamination, friction and temperature.

Mounting force must pass through the ring being fitted, not damage raceways by passing through rolling elements; use approved tools/procedures.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Rings,raceways,rolling elements,cage load transfer guide કરી rotation આપે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Inner ring સામાન્ય રીતે shaft પર,outer housingમાં;કયો ring rotate થાય તે service મુજબ.

Balls/rollers contact load લે;cage separate/guide કરે,main radial load નહિ.

Seals/shields,lubricant,internal clearance,preload contamination,friction,temperatureને અસર કરે.

Mounting force fitted ringમાંથી જાય,rolling elementsથી racewaysને damage નહિ;approved tools/procedures લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Match bearing geometry to radial/axial load and alignment requirements.

Understand why

Deep-groove ball:versatile radial load and limited axial load both directions; common motors/general machinery.

Angular-contact ball:combined load with arrangement-dependent axial direction; paired layouts need proper preload/clearance.

Cylindrical roller:high radial capacity in suitable designs; axial capability depends on flange arrangement.

Tapered roller:combined radial/axial load; setting and opposing arrangement matter. Spherical roller:high load and self-aligning capability within limits.

Needle bearings fit small radial space; thrust ball/roller bearings serve suitable axial duties with their own speed/alignment limits.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bearing geometryને radial/axial load,alignment requirements સાથે match કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Deep-groove ball radial,limited axial બન્ને directions;motors/general machineryમાં common.

Angular-contact combined load,arrangement મુજબ axial direction;paired layoutમાં proper preload/clearance.

Cylindrical roller suitable designમાં high radial capacity;axial capability flange arrangement પર આધારિત.

Tapered roller combined load;setting,opposing arrangement મહત્વનાં.Spherical roller high load,self-aligning within limits.

Needle નાની radial spaceમાં;thrust ball/roller suitable axial dutyમાં,પોતાની speed/alignment limits સાથે.

h.en: 7.1.5 Why select rolling rather than sliding?
h.gu: 7.1.5 Slidingની સામે Rolling કેમ પસંદ કરીએ?

body.en:
Definition / principle

Advantages and disadvantages depend on the duty.

Understand why

Rolling bearings commonly offer low starting friction, standardised replaceable sizes and comparatively simple installation arrangements.

Limitations include contact-fatigue life, shock/contamination sensitivity, noise and size-specific speed/temperature limits.

Sliding bearings may suit very high loads, split housings or suitable hydrodynamic duties, but need appropriate lubrication/thermal design.

Anti-friction does not mean zero friction or maintenance-free in every environment.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Advantages,disadvantages duty મુજબ હોય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Rollingમાં સામાન્ય રીતે low starting friction,standard replaceable sizes,comparatively simple installation મળે.

Contact-fatigue life,shock/contamination sensitivity,noise,speed/temperature limits છે.

Sliding very high load,split housing,suitable hydrodynamic dutyમાં કામ આવે,પણ lubrication/thermal design જોઈએ.

Anti-friction એટલે zero friction કે દરેક environmentમાં maintenance-free નહિ.

title.en: 7.2 Designation:decode only what the system specifies
title.gu: 7.2 Designation:System જેટલું કહે તેટલું Decode કરો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Use the specified applicable standard and manufacturer catalogue, including its current edition/status.

Understand why

Older Indian textbooks citeIS2398:1967, Identification Code for Rolling Bearings. The archived record is marked withdrawn; do not present an old citation as confirmed currentBIScompliance.

For common metric6205:6identifies single-row deep-groove ball type; the dimension series is commonly shown as2 with a suppressed width-series zero; 05 is bore code.

For common bore codes00/01/02/03, the bores are10/12/15/17mm. For usual04and higher codes in the applicable range, bore≈code×5mm; special/slash codes have exceptions.

Suffixes describe seals, shields, clearance, cage and other features; interpret in the selected maker system, not by cross-brand letter matching.

Common mistake / conditions

Confirm currentBISrequirements from the official standards source for actual procurement/legal use; these notes teach identification logic, not standards certification.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Specified applicable standard,manufacturer catalogueની current edition/status જુઓ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

જૂના Indian textbooks IS2398:1967,Identification Code for Rolling Bearings આપે.Archived record withdrawn બતાવે;જૂની citationને confirmed current BIS compliance ન કહો.

Common metric6205માં6 single-row deep-groove ball type;dimension series2માં width-series zero સામાન્ય રીતે suppressed;05 bore code છે.

Common00/01/02/03માં bore10/12/15/17mm.Usual applicable04થી ઉપર code×5mm;special/slash codesમાં exceptions.

Suffixes seals,shields,clearance,cage વગેરે બતાવે;selected maker systemથી વાંચો,cross-brand lettersથી નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Actual procurement/legal use માટે official sourceથી current BIS requirements confirm કરો;આ identification logic છે,standards certification નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

Decode the bore in common metric basic designations6200,6203,6205,6308.

Step-by-step solution

  1. 6200:bore code00→10mm
  2. 6203:code03→17mm
  3. 6205:code05→5×5=25mm
  4. 6308:code08→8×5=40mm

Common mistake / conditions

The code does not give dynamic capacity, exact fit tolerance or an interchangeable seal specification; look those up in the actual catalogue.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Common metric basic designations6200,6203,6205,6308ના bore decode કરો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. 6200:bore code00→10mm
  2. 6203:code03→17mm
  3. 6205:code05→5×5=25mm
  4. 6308:code08→8×5=40mm

Common Mistake / શરતો

Codeથી dynamic capacity,exact fit tolerance,interchangeable seal specification મળતી નથી;actual catalogue જુઓ.

h.en: 7.2.3 Load ratings:C and C0 are different
h.gu: 7.2.3 Load Ratings:C અને C0 જુદાં છે

body.en:
Definition / principle

Basic dynamic rating and static rating are defined reference ratings, not simply allowable working forces.

Understand why

Basic dynamic load ratingC is the constant reference radial load(for radial bearings)or central axial load(for thrust bearings)corresponding to basic rating life1million revolutions; the life equation usesC/P.

Basic static ratingC0 relates to specified permanent-deformation/contact conditions; check equivalent static loadP0 and staticsafetyfactor s0=C0/P0.

Basic dynamic equivalent loadP is the constant reference load giving the same rating-life effect as the actual combined case under the defined model.

Use catalogue factors, load-direction conditions and consistent units; C, C0, P, P0 must not be swapped.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Basic dynamic,static ratings defined reference ratings છે,ફક્ત allowable working force નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Basic dynamic rating C radial bearing માટે constant reference radial load,thrust bearing માટે central axial load છે,જે basic life1million revolutions સાથે જોડાય;life equation C/P વાપરે.

C0 specified permanent-deformation/contact conditions સાથે;P0,static safety s0=C0/P0 જુઓ.

Dynamic equivalent P actual combined case જેટલી rating-life અસર આપતો constant reference load છે.

Catalogue factors,direction conditions,consistent units લો;C,C0,P,P0 ભેળવશો નહિ.

h.en: 7.2.4 Equivalent dynamic load and factor selection
h.gu: 7.2.4 Equivalent Dynamic Load અને Factor Selection

body.en:
Definition / principle

For an applicable radial-bearing case, P=XFr+YFa with factors from the selected bearing catalogue.

Understand why

The threshold involvingFa/Fr, e and catalogue parameters decides whichX, Y apply; there is no universalX, Y for every bearing.

Pure radial load often givesP=Fr in the applicable normal case, but shock, rotation and catalogue conventions still matter.

Calculate axial and radial loads at EACH bearing from the shaft arrangement; do not assign total machine load to both supports without a FBD.

Combine load cases using the appropriate fatigue weighting, not always an arithmetic average.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Applicable radial-bearing caseમાં P=XFr+YFa;factors selected catalogueમાંથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Fa/Fr,e,catalogue parametersથી X,Y નક્કી થાય;દરેક bearing માટે universal નથી.

Applicable normal pure-radial caseમાં ઘણીવાર P=Fr;shock,rotation,catalogue conventions હજી મહત્વનાં.

Shaft arrangementથી દરેક bearingનો axial,radial load ગણો;FBD વગર total load બન્નેને ન આપો.

Load casesને appropriate fatigue weightingથી combine કરો,હંમેશાં arithmetic average નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

Illustrative supplied catalogue case:Fr4kN, Fa2kN, e.3, X.56, Y1.6; assume applicable branch becauseFa/Fr=.5>.3.Static modelP0=max(Fr,.6Fr+.5Fa), C0=12kN, requireds0≥2.

Step-by-step solution

  1. P=.56×4+1.6×2=5.44kN
  2. P0=max(4,.6×4+.5×2)=max(4,3.4)=4kN
  3. s0=12/4=3≥2

Common mistake / conditions

Factors are supplied teaching data, not a claimed actual6205catalogue row; do not reuse them for another bearing type.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Illustrative supplied catalogue caseમાં Fr4kN,Fa2kN,e.3,X.56,Y1.6;Fa/Fr=.5>.3થી applicable branch માનો.Static P0=max(Fr,.6Fr+.5Fa),C0=12kN,s0≥2.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. P=.56×4+1.6×2=5.44kN
  2. P0=max(4,.6×4+.5×2)=max(4,3.4)=4kN
  3. s0=12/4=3≥2

Common Mistake / શરતો

Factors supplied teaching data છે,actual6205 catalogue rowનો દાવો નહિ;બીજા type માટે reuse ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The basic rating life corresponds to90%reliability for a sufficiently large population under the standard reference model.

Understand why

L10=(C/P)^p in MILLIONS of revolutions; p=3 for ball bearings, p=10/3 for roller bearings.

L10h=10^6 L10/(60N), whereN is speed inrev/min.

RequiredC=P[L10required]^(1/p); convert hours to millions of revolutions before using it.

Lubrication, contamination, reliability factors, temperature and installation affect service life; modified-life models need their own factors.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Standard reference modelમાં મોટી populationના90%reliabilityને basic rating life જોડાય છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

L10=(C/P)^p MILLIONS of revolutionsમાં;p=3 ball,p=10/3 roller.

N rev/min હોય ત્યારે L10h=10^6 L10/(60N).

Required C=P[L10required]^(1/p);પહેલાં hoursને million revolutionsમાં ફેરવો.

Lubrication,contamination,reliability factors,temperature,installation service life બદલે;modified-lifeમાં પોતાના factors જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

C20kN, P5kN, N1000rev/min; compare mathematical basic ratings with the sameC/P.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Ball:L10=(20/5)³=64million rev
  2. Ball:L10h=64×10^6/(60×1000)=1066.6667h
  3. Roller:L10=(20/5)^(10/3)=101.5937million rev
  4. Roller:L10h=101.5937×10^6/60000=1693.228h

Common mistake / conditions

This does not prove every roller bearing is better than every ball bearing; actualC, geometry, speed and duty differ.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

C20kN,P5kN,N1000rev/min;same C/P પર mathematical basic ratings compare કરો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Ball:L10=(20/5)³=64million rev
  2. Ball:L10h=64×10^6/(60×1000)=1066.6667h
  3. Roller:L10=(20/5)^(10/3)=101.5937million rev
  4. Roller:L10h=101.5937×10^6/60000=1693.228h

Common Mistake / શરતો

આથી દરેક roller,દરેક ball કરતાં better સાબિત નહિ;actual C,geometry,speed,duty જુદાં હોય.

h.en: 7.2.8 Required dynamic rating and catalogue trial
h.gu: 7.2.8 Required Dynamic Rating અને Catalogue Trial

body.en:
Given and model

Ball bearing, P5kN, N600rev/min, target5000h; hypothetical candidatesA:C26kN, B:C30kN.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Required L10=60×600×5000/10^6=180million rev
  2. Crequired=5×180^(1/3)=28.2311kN
  3. CandidateA26<28.2311:fails basic dynamic-life requirement
  4. CandidateB30≥28.2311:passes this rating check
  5. B predicted L10h=(30/5)³×10^6/(60×600)=6000h

Common mistake / conditions

A/B are invented teaching candidates, not actual catalogue part numbers; B still needs bore, space, static, speed, lubrication, clearance and fit checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Ball bearing P5kN,N600rev/min,target5000h;hypothetical candidates A:C26kN,B:C30kN.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Required L10=60×600×5000/10^6=180million rev
  2. Crequired=5×180^(1/3)=28.2311kN
  3. CandidateA26<28.2311:fails basic dynamic-life requirement
  4. CandidateB30≥28.2311:passes this rating check
  5. B predicted L10h=(30/5)³×10^6/(60×600)=6000h

Common Mistake / શરતો

A/B teaching candidates છે,actual catalogue part numbers નહિ;B માટે bore,space,static,speed,lubrication,clearance,fit હજી જોઈએ.

body.en:
Given and model

Ball bearing at constant speed:load2kN for75%time and6kN for25%time, C20kN.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Peq=[.75×2³+.25×6³]^(1/3)=60^(1/3)=3.9149kN
  2. L10=20³/60=133.3333million rev
  3. Arithmetic average load=.75×2+.25×6=3kN; it would wrongly give(20/3)³=296.2963million rev

Common mistake / conditions

For varying speed, use revolution-weighting n_i t_i in the applicable life model, not time fractions alone.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Constant-speed ball bearingમાં load2kN75%time,6kN25%time,C20kN.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Peq=[.75×2³+.25×6³]^(1/3)=60^(1/3)=3.9149kN
  2. L10=20³/60=133.3333million rev
  3. Arithmetic average load=.75×2+.25×6=3kN;it would wrongly give(20/3)³=296.2963million rev

Common Mistake / શરતો

Varying speedમાં applicable life model મુજબ n_i t_i revolution-weighting લો,ફક્ત time fractions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The course outcome mentions sliding bearings; these basic characteristics complement the rolling-bearing selection unit.

Understand why

For a journal diameterd, lengthL and radialW, mean projected pressurep=W/(Ld).

Surface velocityv=pi d N/60 when d is inmetres; PV combines pressure and velocity for a stated material/application limit.

In a supplied simple friction model, friction force=muW, torque=muWd/2 and power=muWv.

Actual hydrodynamic film thickness, viscosity, clearance, heat balance and startup conditions need a fuller bearing design; PV alone is not proof.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Course outcomeમાં sliding bearings છે;આ basic characteristics rolling selection unitને complement કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Journal d,length L,radial Wમાં mean projected pressure p=W/(Ld).

d metresમાં હોય તો v=pi d N/60;PV stated material/application limit માટે pressure,velocity જોડે.

Supplied simple friction modelમાં force=muW,torque=muWd/2,power=muWv.

Actual film thickness,viscosity,clearance,heat balance,startup માટે full design જોઈએ;PV એકલું proof નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

W4000N, d40mm, L50mm, N600rev/min, suppliedmu.02.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Mean pressure=4000/(50×40)=2MPa
  2. v=pi×.04×600/60=1.2566m/s
  3. PV=2×1.2566=2.5133MPa m/s
  4. Friction torque=.02×4000×.04/2=1.6Nm
  5. Friction power=.02×4000×1.2566=100.5310W

Common mistake / conditions

NoPVallowable or thermal limit was supplied, so do not claim this bearing is safe merely because characteristics were calculated.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

W4000N,d40mm,L50mm,N600rev/min,supplied mu.02.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Mean pressure=4000/(50×40)=2MPa
  2. v=pi×.04×600/60=1.2566m/s
  3. PV=2×1.2566=2.5133MPa m/s
  4. Friction torque=.02×4000×.04/2=1.6Nm
  5. Friction power=.02×4000×1.2566=100.5310W

Common Mistake / શરતો

PV allowable,thermal limit given નથી;characteristics ગણાય એટલે bearing safe એવો દાવો નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose a complete bearing arrangement, not an isolated rating.

Understand why

FBD→radial/axial loads→type/arrangement→speed/life→equivalent load→requiredC→catalogue trial.

CheckC0/P0, min/max load, speed limits, misalignment, temperature, lubricant, seals, clearance/preload and shaft/housing fits.

Confirm shoulder/fillet dimensions, mounting/dismounting access and which bearing permits thermal expansion.

Record full designation, maker, edition and operating assumptions; equal nominal sizes do not prove full cross-brand equivalence.

Can you select a bearing fromC≥P alone?

No. Life target, static capacity, speed, arrangement, fit and environment also govern.

Are matching bore codes enough for interchangeability?

No. Check dimensions, ratings, clearance, seals, fits and manufacturer details.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Isolated rating નહિ,complete bearing arrangement પસંદ કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

FBD→radial/axial loads→type/arrangement→speed/life→equivalent load→required C→catalogue trial.

C0/P0,min/max load,speed,misalignment,temperature,lubricant,seals,clearance/preload,shaft/housing fits જુઓ.

Shoulder/fillet,mounting/dismounting access,thermal expansion કયું bearing લે તે confirm કરો.

Full designation,maker,edition,operating assumptions નોંધો;same nominal sizeથી full cross-brand equivalence સાબિત નહિ.

ફક્ત C≥Pથી Bearing પસંદ થાય?

ના.Life target,static capacity,speed,arrangement,fit,environment પણ governing છે.

Matching Bore Codesથી Interchangeability પાકી?

ના.Dimensions,ratings,clearance,seals,fits,maker details જુઓ.
